description: Fails if the tenancy's Cloud Guard configuration status isn't ENABLED. Mirrors AWS GuardDuty 'threat detection in place'. cloud_guard_configuration is a tenancy-wide singleton -- one record per tenancy, id is the tenancy OCID. NOT YET LIVE-TESTED -- Cloud Guard isn't configured/available on the free-tier tenancy this schema was validated against (get_configuration returned NotAuthorizedOrNotFound there, confirmed 2026-09-24). Confirm against a tenancy with Cloud Guard actually enabled.
